description: The Prometheus metric names, types and labels that dashboards, alerts, SLOs and scorecard controls depend on. Names are part of the contract: renames follow the two-step rule (docs/upgrade.md).

metrics.name: security_collector_findings
metrics.meaning: Findings reported by the latest run of a collector

metrics.name: security_collector_gaps
metrics.meaning: Assets the collector could not cover in its latest run

metrics.name: security_collector_assets
metrics.meaning: Coverage entries (ok + gap) of the latest run

metrics.name: security_collector_last_run_timestamp_seconds
metrics.meaning: finished_at of the latest document (heartbeat; no findings != secure)

metrics.name: security_collector_last_good_run_timestamp_seconds
metrics.meaning: Last run that covered at least one asset (a blind run does not count)

metrics.name: security_collector_expected_interval_seconds
metrics.meaning: Seconds between scheduled runs of the collector (staleness thresholds derive from it)

metrics.name: security_sli
metrics.meaning: Security SLI current value (generators/sli-catalog.yaml)

metrics.name: security_sli_objective
metrics.meaning: Objective: the SLI must stay <= this

metrics.name: security_sli_ok
metrics.meaning: 1 while the SLI meets its objective

metrics.name: security_sli_new_total
metrics.meaning: Findings that entered the SLI's set (new or reopened); first sight = baseline

metrics.name: security_findings
metrics.meaning: Ledger entries by layer, severity and status (open|fixed|accepted)

metrics.name: security_findings_reopened_total
metrics.meaning: Regressions: fixed findings that came back

metrics.name: security_exceptions_active
metrics.meaning: Entries accepted under a valid human exception

metrics.name: security_exceptions_expired
metrics.meaning: Exceptions past expiry (finding reopened / gap counted again)

metrics.name: security_coverage_gaps_excepted
metrics.meaning: Coverage gaps under a human-approved, unexpired exception

metrics.name: security_coverage_gaps_open
metrics.meaning: Coverage gaps not under an exception, per collector (newest documents)

metrics.name: security_time_to_fix_days
metrics.meaning: Time to fix (quantile 0.5 and 1) over fixed entries

metrics.name: security_time_to_know_hours
metrics.meaning: Advisory publication -> first detection on an already-covered asset (30 days)

metrics.name: security_time_to_know_detections
metrics.meaning: Detections counted for time-to-know (30 days)

metrics.name: security_contract_invalid_documents
metrics.meaning: Findings documents rejected by schema validation in the last merge

metrics.name: security_ledger_last_update_timestamp_seconds
metrics.meaning: Ledger heartbeat

metrics.name: security_remediation_open
metrics.meaning: Open findings being remediated

metrics.name: security_remediation_overdue
metrics.meaning: Open findings past their remediation SLO

metrics.name: security_time_to_remediate_days
metrics.meaning: Opened (or reopened) -> fixed, closed items

metrics.name: security_remediation_slo_seconds
metrics.meaning: Remediation SLO per class (label severity carries the class, incl. kev_exposed)

metrics.name: security_remediation_unassigned
metrics.meaning: Open items without an owner

metrics.name: security_remediation_last_update_timestamp_seconds
metrics.meaning: Remediation tracker heartbeat

metrics.name: security_export_last_success_timestamp_seconds
metrics.meaning: When the export sink last completed

metrics.name: security_export_failures_total
metrics.meaning: Failed export runs

metrics.name: security_export_consecutive_failures
metrics.meaning: Export runs failed in a row (0 = the last one worked)

metrics.name: security_export_items
metrics.meaning: Last export run: tickets or events by result

metrics.name: security_score
metrics.meaning: Score 0-100 (one label set per series: dimension, pillar, function, or dimension+pillar)

metrics.name: security_score_overall
metrics.meaning: Overall = the weakest dimension's score

metrics.name: security_score_threshold
metrics.meaning: A dimension below this fails the scorecard

metrics.name: security_score_pass
metrics.meaning: 1 while every dimension meets its threshold

metrics.name: security_score_controls
metrics.meaning: Controls per dimension and result (pass|fail|na)

metrics.name: security_score_regressions_total
metrics.meaning: Times the dimension dropped below its threshold

metrics.name: security_attestations
metrics.meaning: Attested controls by state (valid|expiring|expired|missing)

metrics.name: security_scorecard_last_compute_timestamp_seconds
metrics.meaning: When the scorecard was last computed

metrics.name: security_runner_tick_timestamp_seconds
metrics.meaning: Heartbeat of the trigger: when the runner last ticked

metrics.name: security_runner_tick_max_gap_seconds
metrics.meaning: The tick heartbeat is overdue after this (runner.tick_stale_after, default 1h)

metrics.name: security_runner_sink_last_success_timestamp_seconds
metrics.meaning: When the sink last accepted the metrics (sink = <index>-<type>)

metrics.name: security_runner_sink_failures_total
metrics.meaning: Failed deliveries

metrics.name: security_runner_sink_consecutive_failures
metrics.meaning: Deliveries failed in a row (0 = the last one worked)

metrics.name: security_runner_job_last_success_timestamp_seconds
metrics.meaning: When the job last succeeded

metrics.name: security_runner_job_last_attempt_timestamp_seconds
metrics.meaning: When the job last started

metrics.name: security_runner_job_duration_seconds
metrics.meaning: Duration of the last run

metrics.name: security_runner_job_last_exit_code
metrics.meaning: Exit code of the last run (0 = ok)

metrics.name: security_runner_job_runs_total
metrics.meaning: Runs

metrics.name: security_runner_job_failures_total
metrics.meaning: Failed runs

metrics.name: security_runner_job_expected_interval_seconds
metrics.meaning: Seconds between scheduled runs (local jobs only)

metrics.name: security_runner_info
metrics.meaning: Runner version and the product release it was installed as (value 1)

metrics.name: security_metrics_published_timestamp_seconds
metrics.meaning: When the hub last published these metrics

metrics.name: security_exporter_files
metrics.meaning: Number of .prom files the exporter serves

metrics.name: security_runner_job_missed_slots_total
metrics.meaning: TARGET (RUNNER-D2): slots that will never run: skipped by max_delay or given up after retries

metrics.name: security_runner_job_pending_slot_timestamp_seconds
metrics.meaning: TARGET (CLI-D1/RUNNER-D2): the scheduled slot that is due and not done yet (absent when none); lateness = now - value
